professionalSummary.text: Maintains CI runners and build caches for a multi-repository codebase.
professionalSummary.witness: Platform engineer at Quillstack from September 2020 to June 2024, maintaining the CI runners and the remote build cache for about 140 repositories, including the Linux and macOS runner pools.

experienceHighlights.text: Has been the accountable technical lead for a build-system or CI migration.
experienceHighlights.witness: the former director of engineering confirmed in writing that the candidate was the designated technical lead for the build-system migration from April 2022 to January 2023 and that the cutover schedule was the candidate's responsibility.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Wrote the design document for moving the repositories from hand-written build scripts to Bazel.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Wrote the design document for moving the repositories from hand-written build scripts to Bazel; the architecture review board approved it in May 2022 with the candidate recorded as author and decision owner.

skills.text: Writes runbooks and supports product engineers using the build tooling.
skills.witness: Wrote the onboarding runbook for the new build setup and covered the platform help channel on a weekly rota, answering build questions from product engineers.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's experience with maintaining CI runners and build caches, leading a build migration, writing runbooks, and managing CI infrastructure in Terraform. They do not establish the candidate's design and delivery of a formal training course.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials provide sufficient evidence to support some requirements but lack evidence for others, necessitating human review.

evidence.text: Platform engineer at Quillstack from September 2020 to June 2024, maintaining the CI runners and the remote build cache for about 140 repositories, including the Linux and macOS runner pools.

the former director of engineering confirmed in writing that the candidate was the designated technical lead for the build-system migration from April 2022 to January 2023 and that the cutover schedule was the candidate's responsibility.
Wrote the onboarding runbook for the new build setup and covered the platform help channel on a weekly rota, answering build questions from product engineers.
Managed the CI fleet through Terraform modules; every change went through a pull request reviewed by a second platform engineer.

Work sample: a redacted copy of the Bazel migration design document, including its decision table (eight decisions, each initialled by the candidate as decider) and the per-repository cutover checklist.
evidence.notes: The work sample shows the candidate's involvement in the migration but does not explicitly state that they designed and ran a formal training course.

missingEvidence: Design and delivery of a formal training course for engineers
